# Kvasir

> Kvasir is a decentralized AI inference network (DePIN) in devnet preview. It splits large open language models across shared devices — GPUs, CPUs and phones — using the source-available **linkcpp** control plane, so each node holds only part of the model. Contributors earn the **KVR** devnet token for measured compute.

Key facts (accurate as of 2026-09-17):

- **Kvasir** = the network/product brand (self-custody wallet + settlement gateway + node-reward network). **linkcpp** = the source-available engine/control plane it runs on (Business Source License 1.1). **KVR** = the token (on-chain name "Kvasir", 6 decimals, Solana **devnet** only).
- **Ring topology:** every device stores the same model and loads only its contiguous layer window, opening one link to its predecessor and one to its successor. Hidden-state boundaries circulate around the ring; the last node returns the token. There is no central master on the data path; a hub plans placement.
- **Rewards** are for measured compute. Roles: **compute node** (per contribution unit ≈ 1k tokens × layer share × performance tier S/A/B/C = ×1.5/×1.25/×1.0/×0.7), **gateway host** and **hub host** (hourly uptime; the gateway also gets an inference bonus). Roles stack; rewards are paid in KVR to each node owner's wallet.
- **Developers:** OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible gateway (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`, `/v1/models`, `/anthropic/v1/messages`). Two ways to pay: pay-per-call (sign an on-chain KVR payment per request, no API key) or prepaid credits with an API key that an AI agent can self-issue from a wallet secret — see [llms-full.txt](https://kvasir-ai.net/llms-full.txt) and https://kvasir-ai.net/docs/api.
- **Compliance:** KVR is a devnet utility / contribution token — not a tradable mainnet asset, price, or investment, and nothing on the site is a promise of financial return. Wallet keys stay on the user's device; on devnet, staked KVR and prepaid credits are held by the gateway treasury until an on-chain staking program ships.
- **Verified on the test fleet:** a 122B model (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B) served end to end across 3 physical machines; separate node wallets each credited for their layer share; wallets on web/desktop/iOS/Android. NPU support is in progress.
- **Terms & privacy:** https://kvasir-ai.net/legal
- **Name origin:** in Norse myth, Kvasir was formed from the pooled essence of all the gods and was the wisest being; his blood became the Mead of Poetry, sharing wisdom with all.
- **Languages:** the homepage is available in English, 한국어, 中文, Español, 日本語, Français, Deutsch, Nederlands and Bahasa Indonesia.

## Links

- [Homepage](https://kvasir-ai.net/): the full marketing site (all sections).
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/louisevandan/kvasir-net): the source-available engine (BSL 1.1); the `p4` branch holds the distributed inference engine.
- [Gateway](https://gate.kvasir-ai.net): OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible inference gateway (devnet).
- [Hub](https://hub.kvasir-ai.net): the linkcpp control hub.
- [Terms & privacy](https://kvasir-ai.net/legal)
- [Full text for LLMs](https://kvasir-ai.net/llms-full.txt): the complete site content as plain text.
